feed.title: BIM Takeoff Research & Publications
feed.subtitle: Expert analysis on BIM 5D cost estimation, AI in construction, and industry trends

entry.title: The $40 Trillion Construction Crisis: Challenges Reshaping a Global Industry
entry.summary: Analysis of construction's existential challenges: a $40 trillion infrastructure gap by 2040, 41% workforce retiring by 2031, and stalled productivity.

entry.title: The Endemic Failure of Construction Project Delivery: Why 91.5% of Projects Fail
entry.summary: Why construction projects consistently fail. Oxford University data shows 91.5% exceed budget or schedule, with mean cost overruns of 62%.

entry.title: AI Quantity Takeoff in Construction: The Gap Between Marketing Claims and Reality
entry.summary: AI takeoff software delivers 40-60% time savings versus marketed 80-90%, with accuracy claims vendor self-reported. RICS mandates professional oversight.

entry.title: The 70% Price Myth: What Really Wins Construction Tenders
entry.summary: Data-driven analysis debunking the '70% price' myth in construction procurement, where 40-50% of tender evaluation is non-price criteria.

entry.title: The Century-Old Innovation That Keeps Failing: What Really Happened to Modular Construction
entry.summary: After 100 years of promises and £500 million in UK failures, modular construction still captures barely 5-8% of Western markets. What works and why.

entry.title: Will AI Replace Quantity Surveyors? The Reality Behind Construction's Digital Revolution
entry.summary: Data-driven analysis of AI's impact on quantity surveying. AI will transform, not replace, the profession - but contractors face a £495,680 question.

entry.title: BIM Adoption at Tender Stages: Why Contractors Resist and What Poland Can Learn from the UK
entry.summary: Analysis of BIM adoption barriers at tender stage, comparing UK success (73%) with Poland's 8.9% contractor adoption. Policy recommendations for 2030.
